Slide 6: A scoped pilot to decide whether this signal earns integration

PROPOSED CUSTOMER PILOT

One vehicle. One mapped course. A decision in four weeks.

Offline replay, then
shadow operation

Use compatible existing cameras and recorded motion signals. Keep the output outside vehicle control.

Customer contribution

Course access, calibration, an independent evaluation capture and an agreed latency budget.

Decision: extend the pilot only if the agreed gates pass.
